Data:Pumps.lower.json.label: Pumps: Lower Level
Data:Pumps.lower.json.desc: These machines are of different and newer manufacture than the ones above. They include something like a generator, too. But they're in even worse condition. I'll need to provide suitable materials and fuel - and I'll need Scholar-level of Forge to jury-rig them.

Data:Pumps.run.lower.json.label: Jury-Rig the Lower Level Pumps
Data:Pumps.run.lower.json.startdescription: The machine roars into life. Sparks flicker. This will take a while.
Data:Pumps.run.lower.json.desc: The pumps sputter and die; but they've done their work.

Data:Pumps.run.upper.json.label: Jury-Rig the Upper Level Pumps
Data:Pumps.run.upper.json.startdescription: The machine roars into life. Water thuds and gurgles. This will take a while.
Data:Pumps.run.upper.json.desc: The pumps sputter and die; but they've done their work.

Data:Pumps.upper.json.label: Pumps: Upper Level
Data:Pumps.upper.json.desc: The Curia installed these pumps to drain the lower levels - but they installed them in the late nineteenth century. I'll need to provide suitable materials and fuel - and I'll need a Prentice-level of Forge to jury-rig them.

Data:Purchase.uncat.json.label: Purchase: Uncatalogued Bundle
Data:Purchase.uncat.json.desc: ITEM: Three occult books of unknown origin and quality.

Data:Pyrus.auricalcinus.json.Label: Pyrus Auricalcinus
Data:Pyrus.auricalcinus.json.Desc: A peculiar pear, with coppery skin that barely dints under the pressure of fingers.

xexts.scrutiny: In our History, this grows only on the uncanny hybrids we call 'Mare-blest' trees. [Although there are Scholar-level Nectar recipes that can force it to burst from dead wood.]
How much exactly is a quire? Enough, that's how much.

Data:R.anbary.lapidary.json.label: Subject: Anbary & Lapidary
Data:R.anbary.lapidary.json.desc: 'Lightning is a little life, and jewels are its eyes.' - Eva Dewulf

Data:R.applebrighteuphonies.json.label: Subject: Applebright Euphonies
Data:R.applebrighteuphonies.json.desc: 'Breath is the temptation of the soul.' Pleasures and insights that the Church would call 'the Secrets', the Sisterhood 'the Mysteries', and the Bureau 'unsanctioned.'

Data:R.auroralcontemplations.json.label: Subject: Auroral Contemplations
Data:R.auroralcontemplations.json.desc: 'To know what will pass in what has passed.' The practitioners of this discipline see endings and beginnings, passages and transitions, in the same mode as dawn and sunset.

Data:R.bells.brazieries.json.label: Subject: Bells & Brazieries
Data:R.bells.brazieries.json.desc: That resonance which lingers from the hammer's touch.

Data:R.coil.chasm.json.label: Subject: Coil & Chasm
Data:R.coil.chasm.json.desc: Worms, Seven-Coils, dangerous places; how earthquakes are bound and why they are released.

Data:R.cracktrack.json.label: Subject: Cracktrack
Data:R.cracktrack.json.desc: In the Tracks of Beasts, in the Convolutions of his own Carapace, in Egg-vein and Shell-shadow, the Many-Eyed One found the Signs which can be History.

Data:R.desires.dissolutions.json.label: Subject: Desires & Dissolutions
Data:R.desires.dissolutions.json.desc: The boundaries between flesh, pearl, and pleasure are equally contingent.

Data:R.disciplines.thehammer.json.label: Subject: Disciplines of the Hammer
Data:R.disciplines.thehammer.json.desc: To purify and to combine the selves and the essences. The Hammer shapes gates and shatters doors, within us and without.

Data:R.disciplines.thescar.json.label: Subject: Disciplines of the Scar
Data:R.disciplines.thescar.json.desc: To master boundaries through their determination. The Scar marks wisdom and regrets; one is often born from the other.

Data:R.door.wall.json.label: Subject: Door & Wall
Data:R.door.wall.json.desc: 'The lock seeks its key, the wall seeks its door, and we who would pass learn at last that they are not our servants.' - Willem Harries

Data:R.drums.dances.json.label: Subject: Drums & Dances
Data:R.drums.dances.json.desc: The first musics were not made by mortals, but taken; from sand-coil and sea-thorn, from flint-heart and dragon-womb.

Data:R.edictsinviolable.json.label: Subject: Edicts Inviolable
Data:R.edictsinviolable.json.desc: The precepts of occlusion and dissolution; their jealous enforcement is the nature of the Calyptra.

Data:R.edictsliminal.json.label: Subject: Edicts Liminal
Data:R.edictsliminal.json.desc: The precepts of limitation and division; established by the enigmatic conclave of Hours sometimes called the Chancel.

Data:R.edictsmartial.json.label: Subject: Edicts Martial
Data:R.edictsmartial.json.desc: The precepts of struggle and conflict which drive the cosmic engine of change sometimes called the Corrivality.

Data:R.ericapaean.json.label: Subject: Ericapaean
Data:R.ericapaean.json.desc: A language of surpassing beauty and allusiveness, revealed through the ecstatic apprehensions of the Orphics, the Eleusinians, and the Sibyls of the Rhine. Ericapaean, these mystics claimed, allows the elaboration of hues, sensations and states of mind too subtle for grosser tongues.

Data:R.fucine.json.label: Subject: Fucine
Data:R.fucine.json.desc: A people lived east of the lost lake Fucino. Horace warned that theirs was the land of witches. This was their language, called by some 'the dry tongue' and by others 'the tongue of witches'.

Data:R.glassblowing.vesselcrafting.json.label: Subject: Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting
Data:R.glassblowing.vesselcrafting.json.desc: 'We are all vessels. Let us contain only what will grace us when the light shines through.' - Thirza Blake

Data:R.glaziery.lightsmithing.json.label: Subject: Glaziery & Lightsmithing
Data:R.glaziery.lightsmithing.json.desc: 'Break a window. What have you made? A way? A new light? A weapon?' - Natalia Brulleau

Data:R.henavek.json.label: Subject: Henavek
Data:R.henavek.json.desc: Kernewek Henavek; the oldest form of the language now called Cornish; or something even older.

Data:R.herbs.infusions.json.label: Subject: Herbs & Infusions
Data:R.herbs.infusions.json.desc: Pluck it, powder it, mix it, warm it, drink it. But not that one.

Data:R.hill.hollow.json.label: Subject: Hill & Hollow
Data:R.hill.hollow.json.desc: The ways of the hill-children and the gods-from-stone. Old paths, old secrets, the songs that still echo beneath the earth.

Data:R.horns.ivories.json.label: Subject: Horns & Ivories
Data:R.horns.ivories.json.desc: The Hunter, the Way, and their memories.

Data:R.hyksos.json.label: Subject: Hyksos
Data:R.hyksos.json.desc: The Shepherd-Kings brought this speech west from Canaan to use in their wards and snares. Had they never come to Egypt, they might never found a way to write it; given its addictive qualities, that might have been for the best.

Data:R.inks.containment.json.label: Subject: Inks of Containment
Data:R.inks.containment.json.desc: The inks in which the Histories are preserved.

Data:R.inks.power.json.label: Subject: Inks of Power
Data:R.inks.power.json.desc: The inks in which the Histories are written.

Data:R.inks.revelation.json.label: Subject: Inks of Revelation
Data:R.inks.revelation.json.desc: The inks in which the Histories are revealed.

Data:R.insects.nectars.json.label: Subject: Insects & Nectars
Data:R.insects.nectars.json.desc: The Hive, the Nest, and the Chrysalis are the three secret principalities of the lesser world. Two of those three know the temptations of sweetness.

Data:R.killasimi.json.label: Subject: Killasimi
Data:R.killasimi.json.desc: If there is speech in Nowhere; if there is a language used by the Dead; if the House of the Moon has a native tongue; then it must be Killasimi. If none of this is true, it is still not a language to be spoken in daylight. Each word breathes woe. Read it, as they say, and weep.

Data:R.leaves.thorns.json.label: Subject: Leaves & Thorns
Data:R.leaves.thorns.json.desc: There is no scent without sorrow.

Data:R.lockworks.clockworks.json.label: Subject: Lockworks & Clockworks
Data:R.lockworks.clockworks.json.desc: The little ways of little machines.
